Hello I would like to request a comic

Red Hair is strong, passionate and fiercely loyal. He is possesive and loves Fox Ears deeply and would burn the world down for him. He is the seme in the relationship

Fox Ears exudes a calm aura and is almost always gently smiling. He is manipulative and cunning but deep down he loves Red Hair enough to sacrifice his own life for him.

The scene starts with Fox Ears giving Red Hair a peck on the cheek. Red Hair deeply blushed while Fox Ears smirked only to be surprised when Red Hair kissed Fox Ears on the mouth in retaliation. The kiss grew deeper and Red Hair ended up carrying Fox Ears to their bed where they have passionate sex (missionary position, Red Hair kisses Fox Ears deeply as if he can't get enough his taste and arms wrapped around him possesively, Fox Ears also has his arms around Red Hair but less tightly) and Red Hair came inside Fox Ears.

Ends with a cuddle scene as they both went to sleep

Please resend if amount is not enough

Hi I'd like to request my 3 childhood friend OCs!

1. Lune [ルネ] 19, 145cm. Stoic, quiet, compassionate
Sleepy artist
2. Mei [メイ] 20, 160cm. Tomboyish, mischievous, stubborn
Idol girl group leader
3. Kaige [ケイジ] 23, 178cm. Arrogant, playful, rebellious
Guitarist and band frontman

Mei is trying to listen to music, but Kaige is singing and playing his guitar too loudly trying to annoy her. (He just really wants to get Mei's attention) Lune is quietly drawing something in her sketchbook. Mei and Kaige start playfully bickering. Mei says Lune will end up kicking his ass if he doesn't shut up but Lune simply smiles and says that Kaige can continue. Mei moves to sit next to Lune trying to escape Kaige. She looks at Lune's drawing, and notices that it's of herself and Kaige being cute and lovey-dovey. Mei is flustered but secretly thinks it's adorable. Kaige ruffles Lune's hair, thanking her for giving him a new idea to tease Mei with.

I'd love both ENG + JPN versions if possible. Thanks!
